title: Frankenstein
synopsis: Ingolstadt. You are a brilliant student. You have figured out, alone in a garret, how to give life. You have not figured out what to do with what you make.

nodes.text: Hands sewn, bones aligned. The kit before the storm.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Continue” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Stop.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He opens his eyes.

choices.consequence: “Stay” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: You collapse. Henry Clerval nurses you for weeks.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: He burns himself in the dark. Walton's ship turns home. You are buried at sea, or in ice, or in a story that gets told.
Walton writes the story honestly. The letter, eventually, becomes the book. Sisters read it by lamps. Generations read it after.
Some say he lives still, on a far island, with cold seas around him. He writes, slowly, on stones, with charcoal. He is, in his way, also an author.
